name: Sign in and load a private workspace
covers: user-scoped client project and invoice data
description: Verifies an authenticated owner can open the workspace and see only their own saved business records.
steps: Open the application while signed out
Sign in through the AppDeploy login screen
Wait for the workspace dashboard to load
expected: The signed-in owner sees the dashboard and only records belonging to their account.

name: Create a client and retain it after refresh
description: Verifies client details are validated, saved and retained after the workspace reloads.
steps: Open Clients and choose Add client
Try to save a client with an invalid email address
Confirm the invalid record is rejected
Enter a valid client name, company and email
Save the client and refresh the page
expected: Invalid email input is rejected and the valid client appears in the client directory after refresh.

name: Create and update a project using a workspace client
covers: workspace ownership validation for client references
description: Verifies projects can only reference clients in the signed-in workspace and progress stays within the supported range.
setup: Create a client named Acme Studio
steps: Open Projects and create a project for Acme Studio
Enter a service, budget and due date
Change its status to In Progress
Try an invalid progress value above 100
expected: The valid project is saved with the selected client and status; an out-of-range progress update is rejected.

name: Create an invoice and calculate outstanding balance
covers: payment amount cannot exceed invoice total
description: Verifies invoice amounts and partial payments are constrained and the dashboard reflects the outstanding balance.
setup: Create a client named Northstar Ltd
steps: Open Invoices and choose New invoice
Select Northstar Ltd and enter an amount of 50000 with 10000 paid
Attempt to save an invoice with paid amount greater than its total
expected: The valid invoice shows KES 50,000 total and KES 10,000 paid; an overpayment input is rejected.
